results.name: Tanium endpoint query speed
results.question: How quickly can Tanium query all endpoints, and what makes that possible?
results.answer: Tanium can query all endpoints in under 15 seconds [1]. This speed is due to the linear chain architecture, which dramatically reduces server load [1].

results.answer: Tiktok shop charges a seller commission on every transaction [2]. Sellers are also required to pay to advertise their products [2].

results.name: Supply chain lead times across three preps
results.question: In my Otis supply chain delay story, how much did material lead times increase, and how did I keep projects on schedule?
results.answer: The material lead times increased from 12 to 16 weeks [1][3], but one source states they increased from 10 to 16 weeks [2]. To keep projects on schedule, the owner worked with the factory to implement partial shipments, allowing mechanics to start assembly immediately with available parts [1][2][3]. Additionally, the owner coordinated with field mechanics to put in significant overtime to cover schedule gaps and meet deadlines [1][2][3].
